$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopRunSummary is the CLEAR MIDDLE STAGE between the full local loop-run.schema.json record and the final loop-result-share.schema.json shared artifact — not a third, independent shape. It is what LOOP_RESULT_SHARING_CONTRACT.md §3's share-flow state machine produces at ALLOWLISTED_SUMMARY_BUILT / UNAPPROVED_FIELDS_REMOVED / SECRET_SCANNED / EVIDENCE_NORMALIZED_HASHED: already a STRICT SUBSET of loop-run.schema.json's fields (every default-excluded category — prompts, responses, repo/file identities, file contents, credentials, hostnames, device IDs, terminal logs, artifacts, user identity — is already gone, same as the final artifact), but STILL UNBUCKETED (duration/retry/token/cost fields remain raw numbers here; bucketing per the coarse-bucketing requirement happens only at the loop-result-share step, §4). It has not yet been previewed, consented to, or signed — verificationClaim is nullable here for exactly that reason (signing happens at RECEIPT_SIGNED, after this object already exists). A LoopRunSummary MUST NOT itself be uploaded — only a LoopResultShare built from one, after PREVIEWED and CONSENT_OBTAINED, may leave the phone (§1, §2, §3).
title: LoopRunSummary
description: The redacted-but-still-local, still-unbucketed intermediate stage between a complete LoopRun (loop-run.schema.json) and a finalized, bucketed LoopResultShare (loop-result-share.schema.json). Built only from a completed or terminal LoopRun (FB-RAT-RES-001) — `terminalState` below is therefore the closed 8-value terminal vocabulary, never one of RunState's 9 non-terminal values; there is no representable non-terminal LoopRunSummary. Same default-excluded denylist as loop-result-share.schema.json (FB-RAT-RES-003) — prompts, responses, repository/file/branch/symbol identities, source code and diffs, file contents or paths, raw logs and terminal output, credentials/aliases/tokens/keys/hostnames, IP/MAC/device-serial/USB identity, generated artifacts, user identity unless explicitly attached, and private comments/human decisions MUST NOT appear anywhere in this schema at all — their absence IS the contract (`additionalProperties: false` below, a deliberate deviation from this corpus's usual `additionalProperties: true` + `unknownFields`-bag convention, chosen specifically because an allowlist-first, denylist-enforced object's whole point is that nothing outside the allowlist can validate).

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

summaryId.description: Stable ID for this summary instance (FB-RAT-COM-002).

sourceRunRef.description: Local-only pointer back to the full loop-run.schema.json record's runId this summary was built from. This reference itself MUST NOT be carried forward into loop-result-share.schema.json — a shared result never discloses which local run produced it beyond the release/engine/terminal facts the allowlist already permits (§5).

releaseIdentity.description: loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §2, §4) — exact identity is safe and required (§4: 'loop ID, release version, and package digest').

engineVersion.description: capability-ids.v1.json's engineVersion — the loop contract/engine surface version (§4).

terminalState.description: Exactly one of loop-run.schema.json RunState's 8 terminal values — never a non-terminal state, and never a free-text reason (§4). A LoopRunSummary for a non-terminal run is not representable by this schema.

terminalReason.description: Same shape as loop-run.schema.json's TerminalReason — category + detail. Carried forward here unbucketed (the category enum is already coarse by construction; `detail` remains local-diagnostic free text and — unlike category — MUST NOT survive into loop-result-share.schema.json, which carries only a fixed-vocabulary terminalReasonCategory, no free-text detail).

nodeStateSummary.description: §4: node-state counts and stable public node IDs 'where permitted' — read as: node IDs disclosed only when the loop being reported on has itself been publicly published (`publishedLoop`). Per-node counts remain RAW integers at this stage (bucketing is a loop-result-share-step concern, §4's coarse-bucketing requirement).

durationSeconds.description: Raw run duration. MUST be bucketed before this document's data may be carried into loop-result-share.schema.json's durationBucket (§4 coarse-bucketing requirement) — kept raw HERE because this document is explicitly the pre-bucketing stage.

retryCount.description: Raw total retry count across all node attempts. Bucketed only at the loop-result-share step.

aggregateCostUsd.description: Raw aggregate monetary cost. Bucketed only at the loop-result-share step.

aggregateTokens.description: Raw aggregate model token count. Bucketed only at the loop-result-share step.

localCloudRatio.description: §8: computed from coarse execution-target-type categories, never host identity. Not a 'bucketed' field in §4's sense (§4 names only duration/retry/per-node-count/token-cost fields as requiring bucketing) — same shape here and in loop-result-share.schema.json.

capabilityCategories.description: The coarse 8-value capability-ids.v1.json `category` enum only — never a specific reverse-DNS capability ID (§4).

scanState.description: Where this instance sits relative to §3's SECRET_SCANNED transition — informative only, documenting this object's own middle-stage status rather than being itself part of the allowlist.

verificationClaim.description: Null at this stage in the common case — signing happens at §3's CONSENT_OBTAINED -> RECEIPT_SIGNED transition, AFTER a LoopRunSummary like this one already exists. Non-null only if a caller chooses to pre-compute the claim before preview (permitted, not required, by this schema).

producedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this summary was built (FB-RAT-COM-004).

TerminalRunState.description: The 8 terminal values of loop-run.schema.json's RunState, duplicated locally, name-identical.

TerminalReasonCategory.description: Duplicated locally from loop-run.schema.json's TerminalReasonCategory $def, name-identical.

publishedLoop.description: §4: 'where permitted' MUST be read as: only when the loop being reported on has itself been publicly published. Node-identity disclosure below is gated on this flag, not on node-ID stability alone.

nodeIds.description: MUST be empty unless publishedLoop=true — see this $def's allOf.

computed.description: §8: a run with zero eligible work reports 'no ratio computed' (computed=false), never a default-to-zero percentage.

ratioVersion.description: Versioned computation method/denominator, same pattern as bucketingVersion (§8, §4).

VerificationClaimLabel.description: RES-004 correction: renamed from the source's unsupportable RUNTIME_ATTESTED. SELF_SIGNED_RECEIPT proves only pseudonymous key continuity; UNSIGNED is the explicit no-key marker (§3: 'never silently omitted').
